resources.string: Shows what people say in videos as text, translated, in a floating box over TikTok or any other app. It reads the phone\'s own sound, so it works with AirPods and other headphones.
I\'ll choose it (word by word, fastest)
Automatic detection can\'t run on this phone, so choose the language below.
Bigger speech models are more accurate but need a faster phone. Automatic picks the best one this phone can keep up with, and steps down by itself if captions start falling behind.

1. Choose whether to detect the video language automatically or pick it yourself, and the language you want to read.
2. Tap Start captions. The first time, allow “Display over other apps” and the sound permission, then wait for the download (30–250 MB depending on the accuracy setting, Wi-Fi recommended).
3. When Android asks to share your screen, tap Start. Only the sound is used, and nothing is saved.
4. TikTok opens. Play a video and the words appear in the floating box. Swipe to the next video and they clear. Drag the box up or down, or tap ✕ to stop.

Speech recognition and translation run on your phone. Automatic detection shows captions a few seconds after the speech; choosing the language yourself shows them word by word. Clear speech works best; loud music under the voice lowers accuracy.
